55200.meaning1: expanding of and bondage to the resort that is the mental representation of form
55200.commentary: (SNa) rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā'ti rūpam'eva kilesānaṃ paccay'aṭṭhena nimittaṃ, ārammaṇakiriya-saṅkhāta-nivāsanaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena niketan'ti rūpanimittaniketaṃ. visāro ca vinibandho ca visāravinibandhā. ubhayen'api hi kilesānaṃ patthaṭabhāvo ca vinibandhanabhāvo ca vutto, rūpanimittanikete visāravinibandhā'ti rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā, tasmā rūpanimittaniketamhi uppannena kilesavisārena c'eva kilesabandhanena cā'ti attho.
55200.notes: A difficult term to translate. See CPB note 22.

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapati, niketasārī hoti? rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati. saddanimitta … gandhanimitta… rasanimitta… phoṭṭhabbanimitta… dhammanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati.

55201.meaning1: bound by gratification to the mental representation of form

examples.text: kathañ'c'āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan'ti vuccati? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na rūpanimitt'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti rūpanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ na rūpanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ na rūpanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan'ti vuccati.

55202.meaning1: bound with a chain to the gratification from the mental representation of form

examples.text: kathañ'c'āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpanimitt'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti rūpanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ rūpanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ rūpanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

55203.meaning1: bound by the gratification from the mental representation of form

examples.text: kathañ'c'āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpanimitt'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti rūpanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ rūpanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ rūpanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

55204.meaning1: following the mental representation of form

examples.text: kathañ'c'āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpanimitt'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti rūpanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ rūpanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ rūpanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

55205.meaning1: ending of material form; cessation of the body

examples.text: āhārasamudayā rūpasamudayo, āhāranirodhā rūpanirodho.

55206.meaning1: path of practice leading to the end of material form

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

55207.meaning1: leading to the end of material form

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na rūpaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me rūpanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ rūpehi. ye ca rūpapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. idam'akkhātaṃ rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.

55210.meaning1: quest for forms; searching for sights
55210.commentary: (SNa) rūpapariyesanā'ti pariḷāhe uppanne sandiṭṭhasambhatte gahetvā tassa rūpassa paṭilābh'atthāya pariyesanā.

examples.text: rūpadhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaññā, rūpasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaṅkappo, rūpasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpacchando, rūpacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariḷāho, rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariyesanā

55211.meaning1: fever for forms; burning passion for sights; strong desire for visible objects

examples.text: so aparena samayena rūpānaṃ'y'eva samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā rūpataṇhaṃ pahāya rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihareyya.

55212.meaning1: appearance of a form; manifestation of an image

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso āgaccheyya lākhaṃ vā haliddiṃ vā nīlaṃ vā mañjiṭṭhaṃ vā ādāya. so evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ imasmiṃ ākāse rūpaṃ likhissāmi, rūpapātubhāvaṃ karissāmī'ti.

55213.meaning1: suitable reason; appropriate cause; good reason
55213.commentary: (KVa) aññatra tathārūpappaccayā'ti tathārūpe kāraṇe asati kevalaṃ senaṃ dassan'atthāya gacchato pade pade dukkaṭaṃ, dassan'ūpacāre ṭhatvā passato pācittiyaṃ.

examples.text: aññatra tathā rūpappaccayā'ti ṭhapetvā tathārūpappaccayaṃ.
katamo ca, bhikkhave, sāmiso vimokkho? rūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho sāmiso vimokkho. katamo ca, bhikkhave, nirāmiso vimokkho? arūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho nirāmiso vimokkho.

55215.meaning1: experiencing sights; conscious of material form
55215.meaning2: experiencing sight; conscious of material form
55215.commentary: (SNa) rūpappaṭisaṃvedī'ti nīlapīt'ādi-bhedaṃ ārammaṇaṃ vavatthāpento rūpaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ karoti, tasmā rūpappaṭisaṃvedī nāma hoti.

examples.text: idha pana, upavāṇa, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.

55216.meaning1: with form as a support; establish on matter

examples.text: upayo, bhikkhave, avimutto, anupayo vimutto. rūp'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, rūp'ārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.

55217.meaning1: who measures by appearance; appraising by form; who judges on the basis of external looks
55217.commentary: (ANa) pañca'me rūpe pamāṇaṃ gahetvā pasanno rūpappamāṇo nāma

examples.text: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

55218.meaning1: who has confidence in appearances; whose faith is based on form; pleased by form
55218.commentary: (ANa) pañca'me rūpe pamāṇaṃ gahetvā pasanno rūpappamāṇo nāma. rūpappasanno'ti tass'eva atthavacanaṃ.

examples.text: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

55219.meaning1: imprisoned by form; held captive by material form
55219.meaningLit: bound with the bond of form

examples.text: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano rūpabandhanabaddho santarabāhirabandhanabaddho atīradassī apāradassī, baddho jīyati baddho mīyati baddho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.

55220.commentary: (SNa) rūpabalan'ti-ādīsu rūpasampatti rūpabalaṃ, bhogasampatti bhogabalaṃ, ñātisampatti ñātibalaṃ, puttasampatti puttabalaṃ, sīlasampatti sīlabalaṃ. (SNt) rūpasampatti rūpabalaṃ taṃsamaṅgino upatthambhakabhāvato. esa nayo sesesu'pi. balāni hi sattānaṃ vuḍḍhiyā upatthambhakapaccayo hoti, yathā taṃ āhāro.

examples.text: katamāni pañca? rūpabalaṃ, bhogabalaṃ, ñātibalaṃ, puttabalaṃ, sīlabalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṃ ajjhāvasatī'ti.

55221.meaning1: because of the power of beauty

examples.text: na, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalahetu vā bhogabalahetu vā ñātibalahetu vā puttabalahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. sīlabalahetu kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.

55222.meaning1: existence in the realm of form

examples.text: kati pan'āvuso, bhavā'ti? tayo'me, āvuso, bhavā, kāmabhavo, rūpabhavo, arūpabhavo'ti.
rūpadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho rūpabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ bhante

55223.meaning1: enjoyment of forms; pleasure in sights

55224.meaning1: made from sights; consists of material forms
55224.meaning2: made of sights; consisting of material forms
55224.commentary: (SNa) tassa rūpamayo vego'ti samuddassa appamāṇo ūmimayo vego viya tassā'pi cakkhusamuddassa samosarantassa nīlādi-bhedassa ārammaṇassa vasena appameyyo rūpamayo vego veditabbo.

examples.text: cakkhu, bhikkhave, purisassa samuddo, tassa rūpamayo vego.

55226.meaning1: taking pleasure in forms; pleased by sights

examples.text: cakkhuṃ kho, māgaṇḍiya, rūp'ārāmaṃ rūparataṃ rūpasammuditaṃ. taṃ tathāgatassa dantaṃ guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ saṃvutaṃ, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

55227.meaning1: taking pleasure in material form; delighting in materiality
55227.commentary: (NIDD1a) rūp'ārāman'ti rūpaṃ ārāmaṃ assā'ti rūp'ārāmaṃ. rūpe ratan'ti rūparataṃ. rūpe santuṭṭhī'ti rūpasammuditaṃ.

examples.text: rūp'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, rūparatassa rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

55228.meaning1: taste for forms; pleasure in sights
55228.commentary: (SNt) arasarūpo'ti ācārarahitasabhāvo. rūpassa assādanavasena uppajjanakasukhadhammā rūparasā. esa nayo saddaras'ādīsu.

55229.meaning1: passion for material existence; desire for worldly existence
55229.meaning2: desire to be born in the world of form

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ rūparāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ bhavarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ avijjaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ asmimānaṃ samūhanati.
rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā, imāni pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.

55230.meaning1: craving for material form; desire for sights
55230.commentary: (SNa) rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī'ti kilesassa atthibhāven'eva pana rūparāgaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ karoti nāma, tasmā rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: idha pana, upavāṇa, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.

55231.meaning1: experiencing greed for sights; experiencing desire for material form
55231.meaning2: experiencing greed for the sight; experiencing desire for the material form
55231.commentary: (SNa) rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī'ti kilesassa atthibhāven'eva pana rūparāgaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ karoti nāma, tasmā rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: idha pana, upavāṇa, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.

55233.commentary: (SNa) rūpalābho'ti pariyesitvā laddhaṃ saha taṇhāya ārammaṇaṃ rūpalābho'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: rūpasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpacchando, rūpacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariḷāho, rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariyesanā, rūpapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpalābho

55234.meaning1: thought about forms; conception of sights

examples.text: rūpadhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaññā, rūpasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaṅkappo, rūpasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpacchando, rūpacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariḷāho, rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariyesanā

55235.meaning1: freed by the exhaustion of form; liberated through the dissolution of matter

examples.text: rūpasaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.

55236.meaning1: free from classification in terms of form
55236.commentary: (SNa) rūpasaṅkhāya vimutto'ti āyatiṃ rūpassa anuppattiyā rūp'ārūpakoṭṭhāsena'pi evarūpo nāma bhavissatī'ti vohārassa'pi paṭipassaddhattā rūpapaṇṇattiyā'pi vimutto.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yena rūpe tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya taṃ rūpaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tāl'āvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ. rūpasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo.

55237.meaning1: freed from classification according to form
55237.commentary: (SNa) rūpasaṅkhāya vimutto'ti āyatiṃ rūpassa anuppattiyā rūp'ārūpakoṭṭhāsena'pi evarūpo nāma bhavissatī'ti vohārassa'pi paṭipassaddhattā rūpapaṇṇattiyā'pi vimutto.

examples.text: rūpasaṅkhāvimutto ho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.

55238.meaning1: classification of form; grouping of materiality

examples.text: tividhena rūpasaṅgaho, sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ, anidassanasappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ, anidassana-appaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ.

55239.meaning1: thoughts about sights; intention regarding forms

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, cetanākāyā, rūpasañcetanā, saddasañcetanā, gandhasañcetanā, rasasañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhammasañcetanā.

55241.meaning1: recognition of form; perception of matter; concept of materiality; (comm) existence in the realm of form
55241.commentary: (SNa) paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā cā'ti ettha paṭighasaññāvasena kāmabhavo gahito, rūpasaññāvasena rūpabhavo. tesu dvīsu gahitesu arūpabhavo gahito'va hoti bhavasaṅkhepenā'ti.

examples.text: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma
yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā ca, etth'esā chijjate jaṭā'ti.

55243.meaning1: who is percipient of the body; who is conscious of materiality

examples.text: aṭṭh'imāni, bhikkhave, abhibh'āyatanāni. katamāni aṭṭha? ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī'ti, evaṃsaññī hoti. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ abhibh'āyatanaṃ.
vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.

55244.meaning1: similar in form (to); with the same appearance (as)

examples.text: revato tesaṃ kathaṃ sutvā cintesi, ayaṃ dārikā daharā paṭhamavaye ṭhitā, imissā kira evaṃvidhaṃ rūpaṃ mama ayyikāya rūpasadisaṃ bhavissati, pucchissāmi tāva nesaṃ adhippāyan'ti cintetvā āha, tumhe kiṃ kathethā'ti? tāta, ayaṃ dārikā ayyikā viya te jaraṃ pāpuṇātū'ti vadāmā'ti.

55245.meaning1: sights, sounds, smells, tastes and touches
55245.constructionSummary: rūpa + sadda + gandha + rasa + phoṭṭhabba + āni
55245.construction:
rūpa + sadda + gandha + rasa + phoṭṭhabba + āni
rūpasaddagandharasaphoṭṭhabba + āni
55245.compound: dvanda (rūpāni ca saddā ca gandhā ca rasā ca phoṭṭhabbāni ca)

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño rāj'antepuraṃ hatthisammaddaṃ assasammaddaṃ rathasammaddaṃ rajjanīyāni rūpa-sadda-gandha-rasa-phoṭṭhabbāni, yāni na pabbajitassa sāruppāni. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dasamo ādīnavo rāj'antepurappavesane.

55246.meaning1: source of material form; arising of the body; origination of materiality

examples.text: āhārasamudayā rūpasamudayo, āhāranirodhā rūpanirodho.

55249.meaning1: contact with forms; impression of sights

examples.text: rūpadhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaññā, rūpasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaṅkappo, rūpasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasamphasso, rūpasamphassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasamphassajā vedanā

55250.meaning1: produced by contact with forms; caused by the impression of sights; born from form experience

examples.text: rūpadhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaññā, rūpasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaṅkappo, rūpasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasamphasso, rūpasamphassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasamphassajā vedanā, rūpasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpacchando, rūpacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariḷāho, rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariyesanā, rūpapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpalābho

55251.meaning1: generated by sights; produced by forms
55251.commentary: (THa) tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā rūpasambhavā'ti tassa evarūpassa puggalassa rūpasambhavā rūp'ārammaṇā sukh'ādi-bhedena anekā vedanā kiles'uppattihetubhūtā vaḍḍhanti.

examples.text: tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā rūpasambhavā, abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittam'ass'ūpahaññati, evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbānam'uccati.

55252.meaning1: pleased with forms; enjoying sights; happy with shapes

examples.text: cakkhuṃ kho, māgaṇḍiya, rūp'ārāmaṃ rūparataṃ rūpasammuditaṃ. taṃ tathāgatassa dantaṃ guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ saṃvutaṃ, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

55253.meaning1: happy with material form; pleased with materiality
55253.commentary: (NIDD1a) rūp'ārāman'ti rūpaṃ ārāmaṃ assā'ti rūp'ārāmaṃ. rūpe ratan'ti rūparataṃ. rūpe santuṭṭhī'ti rūpasammuditaṃ.

examples.text: rūp'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, rūparatassa rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.

55254.meaning1: associated with matter; connected with materiality

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato rūpasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.

55255.meaning1: overcoming the fetter of form; surmounting the material bond; going beyond attachment to matter

examples.text: virato kāmasaññāya, rūpasaṃyojan'ātigo, nandīrāgaparikkhīṇo, so gambhīre na sīdatī'ti.

55256.meaning1: name of grammatical treatise by Buddhappiya in the Kaccāyana tradition; Padarūpasiddhi

examples.text: katihi [katīhi rūpasiddhi oloketabbā] tvaṃ, godhe, dhammehi samannāgataṃ sotāpannapuggalaṃ ājānāsi avinipātadhammaṃ niyataṃ sambodhiparāyaṇan'ti?

55264.meaning1: (understanding of the) subtlety of matter; fineness of form
55264.commentary: (ANa) rūpasokhummena samannāgato hotī'ti rūpe saṇha-sukhuma-lakkhaṇa-pariggāhakena ñāṇena samannāgato hoti.

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu rūpasokhummena samannāgato hoti paramena, tena ca rūpasokhummena aññaṃ rūpasokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na samanupassati, tena ca rūpasokhummena aññaṃ rūpasokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na pattheti.

55265.meaning1: (understanding of the) subtlety of matter; fineness of form
55265.commentary: (ANa) rūpasokhummataṃ ñatvā'ti rūpakkhandhassa saṇha-sukhuma-lakkhaṇa-pariggāhakena ñāṇena sukhumataṃ jānitvā.

examples.text: rūpasokhummataṃ ñatvā, vedanānañ'ca sambhavaṃ, saññā yato samudeti, atthaṃ gacchati yattha ca, saṅkhāre parato ñatvā, dukkhato no ca attato.

55266.meaning1: material; physical; having material form; possessing form
55266.synonym: āmisa, oḷārika, kabaliṅkāra, kabaḷiṅkāra, kabaḷiṃkāra, kabaḷīkāra, kavaḷīkāra, rūpī
55266.commentary: (MNa) rūpavantaṃ vā attānan'ti arūpaṃ attā'ti gahetvā chāyāvantaṃ rukkhaṃ viya taṃ attānaṃ rūpavantaṃ samanupassati.

examples.text: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ, ahaṃ rūpaṃ, mama rūpan'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
daharā tvaṃ rūpavatī, aham'pi daharo yuvā, pañc'aṅgikena turiyena, ehi kheme ramāmase.
haricandanalitt'aṅgiṃ, kāsik'uttamadhāriniṃ, taṃ maṃ rūpavatiṃ santiṃ, kassa ohāya gacchasi.

rūpavicāro loke… saddavicāro loke… gandhavicāro loke… rasavicāro loke… phoṭṭhabbavicāro loke… dhammavicāro loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.

55269.meaning1: thinking about form; thought about shapes

examples.text: rūpavitakko loke… saddavitakko loke… gandhavitakko loke… rasavitakko loke… phoṭṭhabbavitakko loke… dhammavitakko loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.

55270.meaning1: change and alteration of physical form

examples.text: tassa rūpavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.

55271.meaning1: change, fading and ending of form; alteration, disappearance and cessation of sights

examples.text: rūp'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā rūparatā rūpasammuditā. rūpavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti. sadd'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā saddaratā saddasammuditā.

55272.meaning1: produced by rolling around after the change of form

examples.text: tassa rūpavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca anupādāya ca paritassati.

55273.meaning1: born from rolling around after the change of form

examples.text: tassa rūpavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivattijā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca upādāya ca paritassati.

55274.meaning1: rolling around after the change of form
55274.commentary: (MNa) rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivattī'ti mama rūpaṃ vipariṇatan'ti vā, yaṃ ahu, taṃ vata me n'atthī'ti vā ādinā nayena kammaviññāṇaṃ rūpassa bhed'ānuparivatti hoti.

examples.text: tassa rūpavipariṇām'aññathābhāvā rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca anupādāya ca paritassati.

55275.meaning2: (objects of the eye) material forms; shapes; sights

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi ye te cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā adiṭṭhā adiṭṭhapubbā, na ca passasi, na ca te hoti passeyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti?
pañca kāmaguṇā ete, itthirūpasmiṃ dissare, rūpā saddā rasā gandhā, phoṭṭhabbā ca manoramā.

55277.meaningLit: group of five discourses starting with the discourse on not seeing form
55277.sanskrit: rūpa + adarśana + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + pañcaka

55278.meaning1: sense object like a form, etc.

examples.text: sukho imissā paribbājikāya mudukāya lomasāya bāhāya samphasso'ti moḷibandhāhi paribbājikāhi paricārenti sampattaṃ sampattaṃ rūp'ādi-ārammaṇaṃ anubhavamānā kāmasukham'anuyuttā, na evam'anuyutto'ti dasseti.

55280.meaningLit: group of nine discourses beginning with the discourse on sights

55282.meaning1: owing to form; based on material form

examples.text: dissanti kho pana rūp'ādhikaraṇaṃ daṇḍ'ādāna-satth'ādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvaṃtuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādā. n'atthi kho pan'etaṃ sabbaso arūpe'ti. so iti paṭisaṅkhāya rūpānaṃ'y'eva nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.

ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhū, sadd'ādhibhū, gandh'ādhibhū, ras'ādhibhū, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhū, dhamm'ādhibhū, adhibhū, anadhibhūto, adhibhosi te pāpake akusale dhamme saṃkilesike ponobbhavike sadare dukkhavipāke āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiye. evaṃ kho, āvuso, anavassuto hotī'ti.

55284.meaning1: overpowered by forms; overwhelmed by sights

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhūto, sadd'ādhibhūto, gandh'ādhibhūto, ras'ādhibhūto, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhūto, dhamm'ādhibhūto, adhibhūto, anadhibhū, adhibhaṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā. evaṃ kho, āvuso, avassuto hoti.

55285.meaningLit: group of five discourses starting with the discourse on not understanding form
55285.sanskrit: rūpa + na + anubodha + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + pañcaka

55286.meaningLit: group of five discourses starting with the discourse on not comprehending form
55286.sanskrit: rūpa + na + abhisamaya + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + pañcaka

55287.meaning1: fact of impermanence of form; fact of instability of matter

examples.text: rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, rūpāniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha. rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto, rūpāniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto rūpasmiṃ nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo.

55288.meaningLit: group of five discourses starting with the discourse on not distinguishing form
55288.sanskrit: rūpa + na + upalakṣaṇa + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + pañcaka

55289.meaningLit: group of four discourses starting with the discourse on not making form clear
55289.sanskrit: rūpa + na + prātyakṣa + karman + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + catuṣka

55290.meaningLit: group of five discourses starting with the discourse on not differentiating form
55290.sanskrit: rūpa + na + prati + upalakṣaṇa + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + pañcaka

55291.meaningLit: group of five discourses starting with the discourse on not reviewing form
55291.sanskrit: rūpa + na + prati + upekṣaṇa + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + pañcaka

55292.meaningLit: group of five discourses starting with the discourse on not penetrating form
55292.sanskrit: rūpa + aprativedha + ādi + sūkta, sūtra (bsk) + pañcaka

55293.meaning1: on account of being material and fleshly

55294.meaning1: due to the absence of the material and fleshly

55295.meaning1: field of forms; realm of sights; material dimension
55295.commentary: (NPa) rūp'āyatanan'ti ruppanasabhāvaṃ das'āyatanaṃ, rūpīni das'āyatanānī'ti attho. ruppanalakkhaṇena ekalakkhaṇattā imāni desitānī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? rūp'āyatanaṃ sadd'āyatanaṃ gandh'āyatanaṃ ras'āyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabb'āyatanaṃ dhamm'āyatanaṃ
tattha diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattan'ti rūp'āyatane cakkhuviññāṇena diṭṭhamattaṃ.

55296.meaning1: based on form; founded on the material
55296.commentary: (DNa) rūp'ārammaṇan'ti rūpakkhandhagocaraṃ rūpapatiṭṭhitaṃ hutvā. (ANa) rūp'ārammaṇan'ti rūp'āvacara-catutthajjhān'ārammaṇaṃ, yaṃkiñci rūpaṃ ārabbha uppajjanakaṃ vā.

examples.text: upayo, bhikkhave, avimutto, anupayo vimutto. rūp'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, rūp'ārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
katamāni dve? rūpārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ arūpārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

55297.meaning1: visible object; field of form; realm of sight

55298.meaning1: enjoying sights; taking pleasure in forms; fond of forms; (comm) living among forms
55298.commentary: (MNa) tattha vasanaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena rūpaṃ cakkhussa ārāmo'ti cakkhu rūp'ārāmaṃ.

examples.text: cakkhuṃ kho, māgaṇḍiya, rūp'ārāmaṃ rūparataṃ rūpasammuditaṃ. taṃ tathāgatassa dantaṃ guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ saṃvutaṃ, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

55299.meaning1: enjoying material form; taking pleasure in materiality

examples.text: rūp'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, rūparatassa rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.
